Elaine: Heads-up — we got a field ask from Acme about upgrade windows for private deploys. They need <1h planned downtime, in-region handoff, and a KMS HSM key rotation as part of the upgrade. Can we sketch options?
Michael: Ack. Short list: 1) Single-window hot-swap: upgrade operator quickly in a scheduled 45-60m window, require IP hold and traffic drain. 2) Staged side-by-side: bring new operator alongside, shift tenants by tenant. Longer but near-zero app downtime.
Priya: For regulated customers the HSM rotation step is the blocker — many require an audit trail + manual approval which adds ~2-4h. Any ideas to reduce that?
Sam: We can pre-stage the rotated keys in their KMS, mark them ready, but do final bind during the window. That reduces active work time. Need clear customer checklist though.
Elaine: Good. How about network ownership? who takes responsibility for BGP/peering change during the window? Acme expects us to own the routing cutover if we promised short downtime.
Rachel: NetOps is comfortable with a defined SLA only if we provide a runbook and a rollback trigger. Otherwise they want the customer to own peering changes.
Michael: Proposal: for <1h windows we require Redwood-run cutover (+ add premium support). For staged migrations, customer-run is fine with our assistant tooling. Keeps liability aligned with payment tier.
Priya: Does that mean adding a checkbox in the contract/field order: "Redwood-managed routing cutover: yes/no"? Need to flag pricing and SLAs.
Sam: Yea, and ops-bot can enforce preflight gating. OpsBot: preflight checks available: dns-resolution, egress-ip-check, kv-cache-warm, operator-health. Run with /preflight-run <customer-id>.
Elaine: Can we draft a minimal preflight checklist for the field team? I can start one but want input from NetOps and SRE. Items: 1) IP reservation verified 2) KMS keys preloaded 3) Telemetry retention policy set 4) Rollback window communicated 5) Contact oncall for final.
Michael: Add: model pin verification and cache-warm percentile >90%. Also sequence-lock snapshot in case we need to rollback to prior model commit.
Rachel: Add BGP AS path confirmation and ACL proofs from customer network admin.
Priya: For HSM-heavy customers we should require a dry-run key rotation in staging and an audit export. Add that to the acceptance criteria.
Sam: OpsBot: note created -> private-upgrade-preflight-4961234567. OpsBot: reminder scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT: run /preflight-run 4961234567.
Elaine: UX question: can we present these options in the console when customers request an upgrade? checkbox for "Managed cutover" with inline tooltip explaining SLA and price uplift. Product tracked item.
Michael: Agree. Product to own copy + pricing. Engineering: define automated rollback triggers (error rate > x or tail latency spike) and expose knob.
Priya: Also need legal to sign off on liability language for cutovers we perform. I'll ping Legal.
Rachel: NetOps will prepare a one-pager runbook and a quick verification script we can include in the console.
Sam: Action list: Elaine draft preflight checklist, Michael spec rollback triggers & console UX, Rachel NetOps runbook + script, Priya legal + HSM acceptance criteria, OpsBot to auto-run preflight.
Elaine: Thanks — let's sync Thurs 10am PT to finalize scope and handoff. @Michael @Priya @Rachel @Sam :thumbsup:
Michael: +1
Priya: +1
Sam: :thumbsup:
Rachel: On it
